title: Answer: measurement recovers a finite part of the structure, and collapse is not derived

statements.text: Observation is finite interaction that recovers only part of the total structure, and decoherence is the loss of accessible coherence. A single realized outcome is not derived from continuity: it needs an added stochastic law.

sources.quote: Observation proceeds through finite interaction, finite duration, finite accessibility, and incomplete recoverability.
The deterministic density equation does not by itself produce a realised outcome.
